purpose: Freeze a finite clinical-trial design, enrollment, endpoint-readout and safety-review lifecycle before source rows, values, formulas, comparators, prices or returns.

repository_evidence.milestone_boundary: Trial evidence requires protocol, cohort, endpoint and analysis histories; approval or registration milestones alone do not reconstruct them.
repository_evidence.incident_quality_boundary: An adverse-event stream is neither a recurring customer-quality KPI nor sufficient clinical safety evidence without exposure, severity, causality and monitoring context.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A latest registry entry or publication cannot be projected backward without protocol amendments, enrollment, database lock, analysis, correction and first-public histories.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: trial_design_phase_randomization_control_endpoint_and_site_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted point-in-time protocol history freezes sponsor, asset, indication, phase, design, control, endpoints, sites, amendments and first-public timing.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: screening_enrollment_randomization_retention_dropout_and_protocol_deviation_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No complete cohort history preserves screened, enrolled, randomized, treated, retained, withdrawn and deviating subjects with denominator and timing semantics.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: database_lock_primary_secondary_endpoint_effect_size_and_statistical_readout_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted source connects analysis population, database lock, endpoint hierarchy, estimand, effect, uncertainty, multiplicity, missing data, correction and first-public readout.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: adverse_event_serious_event_causality_monitoring_hold_and_resolution_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No complete point-in-time safety history preserves exposure, event grade, seriousness, causality, expectedness, monitoring-board review, hold, amendment, resolution and failed trials.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: approval_patent_rd_expense_incident_quality_kpi_or_security_price_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Adjacent states do not identify protocol, cohort, endpoint, analysis or safety-review evidence.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: trial_direction_phase_endpoint_indication_population_threshold_window_or_subset_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing successful phases, endpoints, indications, populations, thresholds or windows before source admission multiplies hypotheses and creates trial survivorship.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_design_enrollment_endpoint_and_safety_score_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining unadmitted components or choosing weights and models is closed before source admission.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: immutable registry, filing, protocol, statistical plan, results or regulator source identifiers
registration, amendment, enrollment, lock, readout, correction and first-public timestamps
issuer, sponsor, subsidiary, asset, trial and security mapping
point-in-time biotechnology and pharmaceutical scope with structural not-applicability
phase, design, randomization, blinding, control and site semantics
indication, inclusion, exclusion, cohort and analysis-population semantics
primary, secondary, exploratory endpoint, estimand and multiplicity semantics
screened, enrolled, randomized, treated, withdrawal and deviation denominators
effect size, uncertainty, missing-data, interim and final-analysis semantics
adverse-event exposure, grade, seriousness, causality, hold and resolution semantics
trial failure, termination, amendment, correction, supersession and true-zero versus missing semantics
complete 2019-2023 manifest and issuer/trial history tests without factor, comparator, price or return values

next_action: Create the Campaign190 append-only attempt ledger, then publish a prevalue checkpoint before terminal reporting.
